metaDescription: Order custom kids badge ID holders in bulk. Perfect for schools and youth events. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Kids badge ID holders need to be durable enough for active use while offering a comfortable fit for smaller frames. Our selection includes vinyl pouches, easy-slide holders with lanyards, and clip-on options that keep IDs secure without bulky hardware. Whether you need them for school field trips, summer camps, or youth conferences, these holders are designed to withstand daily wear. Choose from clear vinyl for visibility or full-color printed badges to add a fun, branded touch. Decoration methods like screen printing or full-color digital printing let you customize each holder with your organization's logo or mascot.
